notes.title: UI Improved/Balance Changes
notes.content: Sanity, battery, and stamina UI changed. After completing a level, your battery gets a full charge. Banana Boy's speed is adjusted to make level progression easier.

notes.title: Small changes for better level progression
notes.content: The amount of batteries available on the map increased from 7 to 13. Sanity now regenerates at a 2x faster rate.

notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content: Audio is fixed. Lights don't flicker as much. Instructions are given in the beginning.
